item.text: {"hypothesis_status":"not_supported","summary":"L008 executed successfully and passed the fixed G01 positive-Tc guard (8.3382 K <= 8.8322 K), but it was not an eligible improvement. Pooled weighted OOF MAE was 7.9577 K versus A05's 7.7526 K, a deterioration of 0.2051 K rather than the required gain of at least 0.01 K. Relative to A05, positive-Tc MAE improved from 8.5051 K to 8.3382 K and high-Tc MAE improved from 28.8502 K to 27.8571 K, but reported-zero MAE worsened sharply from 6.0806 K to 7.1123 K. The cu_o counterexamples confirm this tradeoff, including zero-Tc materials overpredicted by roughly 97–107 K and high-Tc materials underpredicted by up to 72.6 K. Thus the cu_o hist_gradient_boosting/raw expert improves positive and high-Tc behavior but its zero-Tc cost prevents a pooled win.","next_action":"continue","next_focus":"Because the required successful-unique-cycle minimum remains pending, test the untried target-only follow-up to L008: composition input, chemistry routing, global extra_trees/raw, cu_o hist_gradient_boosting/log1p, and other extra_trees/raw, with fe_anion falling back globally. L008 showed that hist_gradient_boosting/raw on cu_o substantially overpredicts reported zeros while improving positive and high-Tc MAE; restricting target compression to this route tests whether it can reduce those extreme zero errors enough to offset the expected loss on positive and high-Tc cases. The hypothesis is falsified as an eligible improvement unless pooled weighted OOF MAE is below 7.742598770753422 K and positive-Tc MAE remains at or below 8.832165507919859 K.","stop_reason":"","limitations":["All results are adaptive development evidence from reused fixed-group training OOF folds, not independent validation or proof of generalization.","L008 passed the deterministic guard but failed the pooled improvement threshold and cannot replace A05.","Chemistry routes are operational composition partitions rather than verified physical material families.","The cu_o route contains only 66 groups and exhibits severe zero-versus-high-Tc ambiguity.","Many allowed configurations remain untried; these results do not establish generalization or identify new superconductors."]}
